title: Field Trip to Chowmahalla Palace on July 30 - MYP 1
detail:
Dear Parents,

Greetings from The Gaudium!

The United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) works to build a culture of peace, eradicate poverty, support sustainable development, and encourage intercultural dialogue through education, science, culture, communication, and information. To take Global Leadership learning beyond textbooks, students will explore the art, architecture, science, and cultures represented in Hyderabad's historic Chowmahalla Palace.

Chowmahalla Palace reflects Persian, European, Indo-Saracenic, and Rajasthani architectural influences. It received UNESCO's Asia Pacific Merit Award for Cultural Heritage in 2010.

Expected learning outcomes:
- Identify multicultural influences in the palace's architecture and structure.
- Develop artwork or literary work based on the antiques and vintage collections on display.
- Critically observe how places of cultural and historical heritage are maintained.

Field trip details:
Place: Chowmahalla Palace
Day and date: Thursday, 30 July 2026
Grade: MYP 1
Time: 9:00 am to 3:00 pm

Students must carry a water bottle, sufficient snacks, a cap, and a raincoat. Aerated drinks are prohibited. The school will provide a packed lunch and water.

Hard copies of the consent form were given to students. The completed and signed form was due back on 28 July 2026.

The school will arrange transportation and teachers will supervise and guide students throughout the trip. Student safety and well-being remain the school's highest priority.

Regards,
Team Gaudium
